answer.original_source: NN, Inc. (company announcement, relayed by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01; original announcement day not stated, event late June 2026)
answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and said 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. The company targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. No dollar capex, unit volume, or award value is given for the expansion, so the record cannot be mapped to a sized question. Separately, the record reports NN's removal from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026 (finance.yahoo.com, fact tier), a market-structure event rather than a fundamental change. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a Simply Wall St narrative projection ($485.5m / $47.9m, third-party view) and an unnamed-analyst estimate ($489.5m / $48.3m, rumour tier); neither is company guidance and neither is matched to any stored piece. The 2026 US$80–US$90m target is a company target, not a result, and its basis is not stated in the text.
